A Usenet release no longer hangs in Verifying, and the extension is on Firefox Add-ons.

## ✨ Added

- **The extension is on Firefox Add-ons.** The Firefox button in the README and on Settings > Apps opens the listing, with the steps to add and pin it, and the manual names it beside the Chrome and Edge stores.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A Usenet release whose files finished very quickly could stay in Verifying for good,** and one already known to be lost could fetch its remaining parts anyway. The files of a release start only after the queue has recorded which files belong to it.
